local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the target-only diff and local evidence against the new-library contribution rules. The test exercises public Spring Boot Data Commons behavior from a separate package without scaffold code, version pinning, Native Image skips, visibility bypasses, prohibited reflection, unsafe external I/O, or legacy metadata files. The reported 0/0 dynamic-access result is valid, so percentage and entry-count mismatch gates do not apply. Forge finalization passed all three native test lanes, metadata validation, style checks, generated-test checks, and statistics generation without changing the publishable tree.
